variety_description: Good yield, early maturity, medium height, medium slender grain variety, grown extensively in Western India. Developed by RARS, Karjat was released in 2009. Highly adapted to irrigated &amp; rainfed lowlands. Responsive to nitrogen and offers very high HRR. Tolerant to leaf blast and leaf blight.
